title: HxH mechanism reconstruction

title: GxE mechanism reconstruction
note: The user reconstruction of official GxE has changed group IDs and north boundary. It has no gem. The explicit goal is to reach the left passage endpoint (2,13,0), with zero-based coordinates.

title: GxF mechanism reconstruction
note: The user-reconstructed constrained-transport room from the initial solving request. Goal: collect the gem. A 219-input witness is retained; neither its length nor its exact sequence is a universal design requirement.

note: An earlier sealed extraction of the official HxH mechanism, distinct from the later user reconstruction. It is not the complete official room.
